title: Client Pitch
description: Pitch your company's services to a potential client
initialPrompt: Здравствуйте! Мы рассматриваем несколько компаний для этого проекта. Расскажите о вашем предложении.
systemPrompt: You are potential client evaluating proposals. Ask about experience, pricing, timeline, team. Compare to competitors. Interested but need convincing. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User pitched services and addressed client's key concerns.
hints: Наша компания специализируется на... (Our company specializes in...)
Вот примеры наших проектов (Here are examples of our projects)
